title: Healix — Branding for Rural Healthcare | Studio 1947
description: Healix case study — Studio 1947 crafted a trustworthy, progressive brand identity for a community-centric rural healthcare initiative in Baruipur, India.
ogTitle: Healix — Branding for Rural Healthcare | Studio 1947
ogDescription: A cohesive brand identity built on trust, innovation and accessibility for rural healthcare.

hero.alt: Misty forested hillside evoking Healix's community-rooted rural healthcare mission

sections.label: Introduction
sections.heading: Bridging the healthcare divide in rural India.
body: Healix is a forward-thinking healthcare initiative focused on improving medical access in rural India. With community-centric solutions, Healix is addressing healthcare gaps in underserved villages and preparing to launch a nursing home to deliver comprehensive, affordable care to these communities.

sections.label: The Objective
sections.heading: A brand built on trust, innovation and access.
body: Healix sought a cohesive brand identity that embodies trust, innovation, and accessibility while aligning with its mission to bridge the healthcare divide in rural India.

sections.label: Our Process
sections.heading: From values to a consistent visual identity.

cards.title: Client Collaboration
cards.body: We began by understanding Healix's values and aspirations, ensuring the design reflected their goals and community-driven ethos.

cards.title: Logo Design
cards.body: A clean, modern logo symbolizing trust, healing, and inclusivity became the centerpiece of their identity.

cards.title: Visiting Card Design
cards.body: We extended this identity into a professional, well-designed visiting card to reinforce brand consistency.

media.alt: Warm, open landscape reflecting Healix's progressive, forward-looking brand direction

sections.label: The Result
sections.heading: A trustworthy, progressive image.
body: Our designs encapsulate Healix's dedication to rural healthcare and future growth. The logo and collateral establish a trustworthy and progressive image, empowering Healix to make a deeper impact while expanding operations.

sections.label: Client Impact
sections.heading: With a refined visual identity, Healix can now:
list: Enhance trust among rural communities and stakeholders.
Communicate their mission visually and effectively.
Expand their presence with a professional brand foundation.

sections.label: Why Studio 1947?
sections.heading: We transform visions into impactful designs.
body: At Studio 1947, we transform visions into impactful designs. Our collaboration with Healix highlights our commitment to crafting meaningful, professional brand identities that resonate with purpose and inspire growth.
